title: A Money type with full operator support
summary: Exact monetary arithmetic in integer cents with currency safety: arithmetic and <=>, stream I/O, then fair allocation (splitting without losing a cent) and basis-point fees.

steps.title: Arithmetic and comparisons
hints: Members `+=`, `-=`, `*=` return `*this`; free `+`, `-`, `*` are built from them.
Every binary operation between two `Money` values checks the currencies first.
`std::strong_ordering operator<=>(const Money&) const` (it throws on a mismatch), plus a defaulted `==`.

steps.title: Stream input and output
hints: Read two tokens with `is >> amount >> ccy`, then parse the amount by hand: sign, units, optional `.` and 1–2 decimals.
On any problem, call `is.setstate(std::ios::failbit)` and leave `m` unchanged.

steps.title: Allocation and fees
hints: `split`: `base = cents / n`, `rest = cents % n`; the first `|rest|` parts get one extra cent (or one less, for negative amounts).
`apply_bps`: `std::lround(cents * bps / 10000.0)` rounds half away from zero.
